jobs.description:
**This position is based in Germany with hybrid or remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.**

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaosâ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit chaos.com.

Role Overview

The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. The role is responsible for driving new institution and student customer acquisition, growing ARR within the existing base, and reducing churn across both segments. The University segment operates through direct, relationship-led sales to institutions, while the Student segment runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey, requiring close partnership with the Ecommerce team to optimise the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and suits someone who wants to build and scale a team rather than maintain one.

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Education sales team, setting clear individual performance expectations, coaching from the front, and stepping into deals directly where needed to support pipeline and attainment targets.

  • Own and scale a proactive, discovery-led outbound motion to win new institution and student customers, continuously refining outreach cadence and qualification criteria.

  • Drive expansion and retention within the existing student and institution customer base, identifying and executing initiatives that grow ARR and reduce churn.

  • Own ARR and pipeline growth within the University segment through relationship-led, direct sales to institutions, tracking key performance metrics and diagnosing and correcting underperformance.

  • Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience.

  • Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership.

  • Partner with RevOps, Marketing, Product, and Ecommerce to ensure Education-specific campaigns, content, and product feedback are prioritised and executed effectively.



Required Experience

  • At least 5 years of sales experience within a SaaS or technology environment, including demonstrated experience leading a sales team with direct accountability for team performance and revenue outcomes.

  • Proven track record of owning a direct sales territory or segment end-to-end, from pipeline generation through closed, retained revenue.

  • Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.

  • Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required.

Required Skills

  • Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed.

  • Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference.

  • Translates ARR and revenue data into clear, defensible strategy, is able to identify where performance is off track, diagnose the root cause, and act on it.

  • Communicates with credibility at senior level: presents team results, forecasts, and strategic needs clearly to VP-level and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Able to build effective working relationships and collaborate cross-functionally across Ecommerce, RevOps, and Marketing: driving digital funnel and conversion improvements for the Student segment without direct authority.

  • Operates effectively with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment: sets own priorities, creates momentum without close direction, and holds a consistently high personal bar for execution and results.

  • Familiarity with MEDDICC or a similar sales qualification framework is an advantage.

We welcome people who value teamwork, stick to their commitments and are curious to explore new ways for achieving mastery. If you believe that you are a good match for the job, just send us your CV in English.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Confidentiality of all applications is assured.

jobs.description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

About the Role

This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. jobs.title: Surveyor I
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. jobs.title: Head of Security
jobs.location: New York, New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

  • Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security.
  • Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation.
  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
  • Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it.
  • Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team.

What You'll Bring

  • Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth.
  • Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook.
  • An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code.
  • Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling.
  • Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you.
  • Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus.
  • Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus.

What's Cool About The Role

  • You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team.
  • A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders.
  • We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

This combination expands our capabilities, deepens our industry impact, and accelerates our vision of delivering a truly connected, end to end platform for custom manufacturers.

As we scale thoughtfully and bring together top talent and new perspectives, this is a unique opportunity to join a company where your work will have visible impact, your ideas will help shape decisions, and your contributions will play a meaningful role in defining the future of a fast evolving product, team, and industry.

Job Description

We're looking for a versatile, hands-on Marketing Specialist who thrives as a generalist and can move fluidly between product marketing content, web production, and performance channels. You'll be the kind of marketer who can write a compelling product page in the morning, build and publish it in WordPress over lunch, and optimize a paid search and social campaign by the afternoon. About the role

This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.

What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.

You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances.   • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.

We’ve recently raised strategic growth investment, and are scaling fast toward an ambitious growth plan - and we’re looking for a Senior People Partner to ensure we get there.

Over the past 6 years, our People team has designed, built, and implemented the people processes that have scaled Street Group from 30 - 230 people. But we know that systems that work at 200 people can break when growth accelerates - and we want to get ahead of that.

This is an opportunity for someone who has been through that scaling journey before to have an oversized impact on a small but ambitious People team to become best in class.

If you know what can impact culture both positively and negatively as a company grows; have experience building systems that both set people up to do their best work AND that scale alongside the business; and embrace AI and the positive impact it can have on employee experience - we think you might do great work here.

Why this role exists now

Our People team is lean - and as we mature as a business, there’s limited capacity to ensure we’re constantly innovating and improving the mechanisms that enable people to do their best work. The role

jobs.title: Founding Account Executive – Benelux
jobs.description:
Your Impact

Tacto is the category leader for procurement in DACH manufacturing. We have strong product-market fit, a proven playbook, and now we're taking it into the rest of Europe.

Benelux is one of our first markets. The Netherlands and Belgium hold a dense base of high-tech and industrial manufacturers, and the category is still wide open there. That's where you come in. You take the region and build it from the ground up. You research the market, find what resonates, and win the first customers and reference logos that everything else builds on. What you learn becomes the blueprint for how Tacto grows Benelux from there. A real greenfield, with the freedom to shape how Tacto wins in your market.

You're not starting alone. A stellar expansion team is your sparring partner, and proven sales assets and a tested approach from DACH are your foundation. This is a highly strategic GTM role where you work hands-on to close the first deals and set the base for everything that comes afterwards. You're based with us in Munich and travel into your market.

Your Tasks

  • Open up Benelux end to end: sharpen the ICP for Dutch and Belgian manufacturing, define target accounts, win the first deals and lay the foundation for the region's growth

  • Run the full sales cycle: discovery, demo, potential analysis on real ERP data, ROI business case, closing

  • Work hand in hand with the expansion team and develop the outbound playbook for your market: messaging, sequences, segments, channels

  • Coordinate the marketing activities in your market so they generate pipeline

  • Feed structured insight back to Product, Marketing and Leadership, and shape how Tacto expands internationally

Your Profile

  • Several years of full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex or technical products and multi-stakeholder buying processes

  • An entrepreneurial mindset above all: you want to build and own a market result, explore what works, and figure out the motion when the local one doesn't exist yet

  • Hands-on and self-driven: you go to market proactively and drive your own pipeline. You've carried a number before and know what it takes to hit it without a machine behind you

  • You grasp complex products and sell value over features, translating technical depth into business impact

  • Fluent, business-level English. Dutch is a strong plus, French an advantage for the Belgian market. We hire for mindset and ability, not origin or native language

  • You're based in Munich or ready to relocate. This is an on-site role - you build Benelux from our Munich office and travel into the market

Who Thrives Here

You run your market like a founder runs a company. You're a hunter, hands-on to the core: you send the first cold emails, run the first discoveries, and do the early, unglamorous work where real traction is won. You go through the mud and build as you go, turning what works into a system the next person can run. And you think beyond the next deal. You're not just winning customers, you're laying Tacto's foundation in your region: externally through brand, network, and reference logos, and internally through the playbook and the case for the market.

Interview Process

  1. Intro call with our Chief of Staff

  2. Deep dive with our Head of Revenue

  3. Get-to-know call with the AE you'd be working alongside

  4. Onsite interview incl. case study and team meetings

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. jobs.title: Product Manager — Kits and Integrated Workflows
jobs.description:
At ONI, we are driven by a profound mission: to propel scientific discovery and combat diseases by granting everyone the ability to visualize, comprehend, and share the intricate microscopic details of life. Our revolutionary Nanoimager and Aplo Platform stand at the forefront of advancing cellular studies on a molecular level, making substantial contributions to the evolution of scientific knowledge. 

We’re looking for a product manager to own our kits and workflows, including EV Profiler and LNP Profiler, now that the concept is proven. You’ll make sure sample preparation, fluid handling, imaging, analysis and reporting software work together as one system, and your responsibility is the complete customer experience, from sample to scientifically meaningful result. The job is making that system rock solid: hardening what’s already on the market, making sure it works the same way at every site, and getting more customers on it without support load growing at the same rate. 


The Role

As part of the Product team, you’ll own the product management of our kits and end-to-end workflows, including the Discovery Kit, EV Profiler and LNP Profiler and their future revisions. You will ensure these work together with automated sample preparation and fluid handling, imaging, analysis and reporting software to deliver reliable, reproducible and intuitive solutions for our customers.  

The initial products have launched, and the work now is making them dependable, repeatable, and scalable for our customers. You’ll create clarity and momentum for the R&D teams by understanding which problems matter, turning customer and market evidence into priorities, and removing barriers to delivering a coherent solution. You’ll grow adoption to routine use across many sites, including bioprocessing and QC settings where results must be reproducible and defensible, and you’ll work with Marketing on positioning and the product story as the portfolio evolves. You will play a critical role in bringing these quality improvements to the market and ensuring that current and future kits maintain their quality over time, and you’ll help define the roadmap for next iterations of existing and future kits and workflows. As a product manager, you’ll be the connective tissue between software, hardware, bioware, support, and the field, acting as the voice of the customer to help internal teams better understand our customers’ needs and problems.  

The role is ideal for a technically curious, commercially aware individual who loves getting hands-on with products, takes ownership of outcomes and thrives on complex, cross-functional challenges. You will work broadly across our platform and alongside US colleagues; the position is based in Oxford and involves occasional travel to customers and our US team (typically 10-20%). 


What you’ll do

  • Understand scientists and their complete workflows first-hand. Work with customers and field teams, study usage and support data, and synthesize their sometimes conflicting inputs into the problems worth solving. 

  • Drive evidence-led product direction and priorities across our solutions with R&D and commercial leaders, balancing customer outcomes, differentiation, adoption, reliability, margin and technical feasibility. 

  • Own the roadmap for our kits (including the Discovery Kit and the EV and LNP Profiler kits) and workflows, balancing quality, reliability, usability and new features. 

  • Build and refine market and product requirements (MRD/PRD) across workflows, from sample preparation (Aplo Flow) through acquisition (Aplo Scope) to analysis (CODI), according to our Product Development Process. 

  • Own validation for each kit and workflow: define acceptance criteria, performance specifications and validation plans, including reference samples and reproducibility across instruments, operators and sites. Work with R&D, who own development and verification. 

  • Drive coherence across our end-to-end solutions, ensuring kits, reagents, lab automation, instruments and software evolve together rather than as disconnected products. Champion reproducibility, usability and reliable results across the complete workflow. 

  • Connect R&D, operations, quality, service, field applications, sales, marketing and customers. Establish feedback loops, clear ownership and effective cross-team decisions. 

  • Own pricing and packaging for our kits and workflows, balancing customer value, competitiveness and margin targets. 

  • Work with Marketing throughout a product's life to shape positioning, the value proposition and the product story as the portfolio evolves, not only at launch. 

  • Lead launch and release planning with R&D, Marketing and the field: set readiness criteria, make go/no-go decisions, and coordinate documentation, release notes and training for each launch or revision. 

  • Create and run webinars and internal training for the field application and sales teams on new products and revisions, and keep an accurate record of what each kit, instrument and software version can deliver. 

  • Track post-launch performance, including adoption, kit reorders, time to first result, reproducibility, support burden, customer feedback and commercial results, and use it to set priorities. 

  • Analyze support tickets, logs and customer feedback to identify recurring failure modes, and prioritize root-cause fixes into the roadmap. 

  • Work with Quality and Operations on manufacturing transfer, life cycle support and end of life, so our kits and workflows maintain quality over time. 


What you’ll bring

  • A life-science background, ideally EVs, LNPs, nanoparticle characterization, imaging or biophysics. Being able to speak the language of our customers is critical. An MSc/PhD or equivalent hands-on experience is a real plus. 

  • Fluency across software, instruments, laboratory workflows and multidisciplinary R&D; comfortable investigating issues hands-on and understanding how the system fits together. 

  • Experience working with empowered, cross-functional development teams: knowing when to provide context, decide on a trade-off and leave the solution to specialists. 

  • Product management (or product owner) experience in life-science tools or instrumentation, ideally taking something from first release to a scaled, supported product.  

  • Experience planning and running launches with Marketing, R&D and the field, from development through adoption. 

  • Commercial and pricing judgement: You can weigh customer value, competitiveness and margin when setting price and packaging. 

  • A quality mindset: You’re comfortable writing acceptance criteria and test plans, and you think about risk, reproducibility and traceability. Exposure to a quality system (ISO 9001 or 13485) is a plus. 

  • Comfort with data: logs, tickets, precision and method-comparison numbers (CVs, site to site). Evidence sets priorities, not the loudest voice. 

  • The ability to lead across software, hardware, bioware, support and field without owning any of them, and to prioritize when everything feels urgent. 

  • Clear writing and organization skills. Requirements, release notes and docs that other people can act on. 


Nice to have

  • Super-resolution or single-molecule imaging experience (dSTORM, PALM, DNA-PAINT), or general microscopy experience (TIRF, widefield, confocal, spinning-disk). 

  • Hands-on EV or LNP work in research, biopharma, gene therapy or drug delivery. 

  • Laboratory automation, automated liquid handling, sample preparation, consumable kits, workflow integration, scientific software or data analysis. 

  • Integrating instruments, software, consumables and automated lab workflows; exposure to verification, validation, quality systems or lifecycle support. 

  • Commercialization, pricing, segmentation, product positioning or product marketing in technically sophisticated markets. 

At ONI, we understand that a fulfilling career involves more than just challenging work - it's about enjoying a well-rounded experience. When you become a part of our team, you not only contribute to groundbreaking research but also enjoy a range of benefits designed to enhance your life both inside and outside the workplace. 
 
As an equal opportunity employer, we prioritize fairness and respect, ensuring every team member thrives regardless of their background. But that's not all - our perks include:
 
Competitive Compensation We recognise and reward your talent. Enjoy a competitive salary that reflects your expertise and contributions, ensuring your hard work is recognized.
28 days of annual leave plus local bank holidays and 4 dedicated wellbeing days.
Private Healthcare and Dental Coverage: Your health matters to us. Access top-notch medical and dental services, ensuring your well-being is in good hands.
Inclusive Culture: Be a valued member of our diverse, inclusive family. Your unique perspective is celebrated here, fostering a culture of mutual respect and understanding.
Health Assured: Your mental health is essential. Access our comprehensive mental health support services for a balanced work-life experience.
People’s Pension: Secure your future with our pension scheme, investing in your financial well-being beyond the workplace.
Perks at Work: Enjoy exclusive discounts and deals through our perks at work program, adding value to your everyday life.

jobs.title: Data Enablement Officer
jobs.description:
At Efficio, we're not just a consulting firm; we're a team of dedicated experts committed to transforming procurement and supply chain functions. Our mission is to drive sustainable, measurable value for our clients through innovative solutions and deep industry insights. Join us and be part of a dynamic environment where your skills and ideas make a real impact.

Efficio is the world’s largest specialist procurement and supply chain consultancy, with offices across Europe, North America, and the Middle East. We’re a diverse team of over 1,000 individuals, representing more than 60 different nationalities and speaking 40+ languages – and we’re continuing to grow rapidly!

Data Enablement Officer

Help shape how Efficio uses data responsibly, securely and effectively.

We are looking for a Data Enablement Officer to establish and lead Efficio’s data governance framework, helping us protect client data while enabling its responsible use across our services, analytics, products and AI capabilities.

This is a highly visible role at the intersection of data, technology, AI, risk and client delivery. You will work across the business to turn complex contractual, regulatory, privacy and security requirements into practical guidance that enables teams to innovate with confidence.

Initially, the role will have a strong advisory and enablement focus: helping teams understand client requirements, assess new uses of data and make proportionate, risk-based decisions. As our governance model matures, the role is expected to take greater ownership of the framework and delegated authority for lower-risk decisions.

What you'll be doing

Establish our data governance framework

You will assess our current data-handling practices and develop a practical, scalable governance framework covering the lifecycle of client data – from collection and classification through to access, use, sharing, storage, retention and secure deletion.

You will develop and maintain policies and standards covering areas including:

  • Client data handling and classification

  • Data reuse and fair usage

  • Use of client data within Efficio products

  • Use of data with AI tools, including third-party and self-hosted solutions

  • Data access and security

  • Retention, archiving and secure disposal

  • Anonymisation and aggregation

  • Third-party data sharing

  • Policy exceptions and escalation

You will also help establish and maintain our information asset inventories, data flows and AI asset registers.

Enable responsible use of data and AI

A key part of the role will be helping teams determine what we can do with data, under what conditions, and with what safeguards.

You will establish a consistent approach for assessing new and changing data use cases, considering factors such as:

  • Why the data was originally obtained

  • Client and contractual restrictions

  • Data sensitivity and classification

  • The proposed use and intended recipients

  • Security and access controls

  • Retention requirements

  • Legal, client and reputational considerations

For AI use cases, you will help define which activities are permitted, restricted, require additional review or are prohibited. This will include the use of prompts, uploaded files and connected data sources, as well as expectations around human oversight, output validation and accountability.

Govern products, platforms and technology

You will define the conditions under which client data can be stored or processed using Efficio products, SaaS platforms, cloud services and AI tools.

Working closely with Technology, Information Security, Legal and Privacy teams, you will assess areas including:

  • Data residency and international transfers

  • Encryption, access controls and logging

  • Supplier and subcontractor access

  • Data retention, backups and deletion

  • Exit and data-export arrangements

  • Use of customer data for AI model training, product improvement or other secondary purposes

You will help ensure that unapproved platforms are not used for client data without appropriate assessment and documented approval.

Support new solutions and innovation

You will work alongside teams designing and deploying new data, software, analytics and AI solutions, providing governance input from an early stage.

Ahead of launch, you will help confirm that the appropriate governance, legal, privacy and security reviews have taken place and that material risks have been appropriately addressed.

Where issues remain, you will recommend practical remediation, escalation or, where necessary, a delay to rollout. Acceptance of significant residual risk will remain with the appropriate executive or governance committee.

Build governance that works in practice

This role isn't simply about writing policies. We want to create a governance model that teams can understand and use.

You will help develop:

  • A clear data governance operating model and decision-rights framework

  • Practical data, AI, security, reuse and retention policies

  • Data and AI use-case assessment processes

  • Risk-classification and escalation models

  • Policy exception processes and decision registers

  • Product and AI platform assessment standards

  • Solution launch-readiness checklists

  • Training, guidance and supporting materials

  • Governance reporting for senior leadership and relevant committees

You will coordinate, advise and constructively challenge stakeholders across the organisation while recognising that responsibility for managing data risk is shared across business owners, data owners, Legal and Privacy, Information Security, Technology and senior governance forums.

Client engagement

This will also be an important client-facing role.

You will participate in client discussions where required, confidently explaining Efficio's approach to data governance, security and responsible data use.

You should be comfortable responding to questions about how client data is accessed, used, stored, shared, retained and protected, translating technical or governance concepts into clear, credible explanations for different audiences.

What we're looking for

We are looking for someone with experience across one or more of the following areas:

  • Data governance or data management

  • Data privacy

  • Information security

  • Technology or operational risk

  • AI governance or responsible AI

You will also bring a practical understanding of modern technology environments, including SaaS, cloud, analytics and AI platforms.

You'll be someone who can operate comfortably between policy and practice – able to understand complex requirements while recognising the commercial and operational realities of a consulting and technology-enabled business.

In particular, you will be able to:

  • Translate complex regulatory, contractual and security requirements into practical business guidance

  • Apply proportionate, risk-based judgement rather than relying on a purely rules-based approach

  • Influence and challenge senior stakeholders constructively

  • Work effectively across Technology, Security, Legal, Privacy and business teams

  • Balance commercial objectives and innovation with appropriate governance

  • Communicate confidently with clients and senior internal stakeholders

  • Build processes and frameworks that are robust without creating unnecessary bureaucracy

  • Navigate emerging areas where the answer may not always be immediately clear

What success looks like

Success in this role will mean that teams understand how to use data appropriately rather than simply being told what they cannot do.

We will look at measures including adoption of priority policies, review turnaround times, reduction in unapproved tool usage, effective management of exceptions, quality of governance reporting, stakeholder feedback and a reduction in recurring governance issues.

Ultimately, the role will be judged on its ability to achieve both sides of our data ambition: protecting our clients and Efficio while enabling appropriate, secure and innovative use of data and AI.

jobs.title: Director Product Management - Identity & Activation
jobs.description:
Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about — in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant. 

The role

We are looking for a Director Product Manager to advance our identity resolution capabilities and build future-proof identity and activation solutions. You will own product strategy and roadmap across both identity and activation, bring a clear point of view on where the market is heading, and turn that into products customers want to buy.

This is a senior role for someone who can operate at two altitudes. You set direction and vision, and you are also hands-on: close to customers, close to engineering, and comfortable making the calls on what gets built and in what order. You will play a meaningful part in expanding our client base, which means you understand the market, the buyers, and what it takes to win them.


What You'll Do:

  • Own the product vision and roadmap for identity resolution and activation, and make the prioritization calls that keep the team focused on what matters most.

  • Advance our identity resolution product: graph building and enrichment, cross-device and cross-identifier linking, and interoperability.

  • Own the activation side with equal weight: audience activation, data orchestration, and delivery across a broad and growing set of destinations, including platforms and DSPs, in cloud-native environments.

  • Develop a clear understanding of the market and competitive landscape, and translate it into product positioning and roadmap decisions that expand the client base.

  • Partner directly with customers and commercial teams to understand what they need, and translate commercial requirements into clear, buildable specifications for engineering.

  • Work hands-on with engineering day to day to deliver, unblock decisions quickly, and keep the roadmap moving.

  • Own privacy and data governance considerations across the product, so that identity and activation are built to a privacy-first standard from the start.

  • Define the success metrics for the products you own, and use them to guide investment and iteration.


Who You Are:

 

  • Significant product management experience in AdTech, MarTech, or B2B data platforms, with a track record of owning products end to end.

  • Deep domain expertise in identity resolution and device/identity graphs: how graphs are built, enriched, maintained, and measured.

  • Strong experience in the activation and data movement domain: audience activation, destination integrations, and cloud-native or composable data architectures.

  • A clear, informed point of view on where the identity and activation market is heading, and the commercial judgment to know which customers and use cases to build for.

  • A demonstrated record of helping expand a product's customer base, ideally with platforms, DSPs, media networks, or similar AdTech customers.

  • Proven ability to work directly with customers and commercial teams and translate their requirements into specifications engineering can build against without a long back-and-forth.

  • Hands-on delivery experience: writing specs, prioritizing ruthlessly, and shipping alongside engineering in a fast-moving environment.

  • Comfort setting direction and operating with ambiguity in an early-stage environment.

  • Working knowledge of the privacy and consent landscape and how it shapes data products.

  • Curiosity about how AI is changing product configuration, data discovery, and activation workflows.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE BRAND
 
At Karl Lagerfeld, we are driven by Karl’s mantra: “Embrace the present and invent the future.”
 
Always contemporary and forward-looking, the House of KARL LAGERFELD shares the creative vision and design aesthetic of its iconic founder, Karl Lagerfeld.
 
We are the only fashion house that carries Karl’s name on its door and we strive to live up to this responsibility in everything we do, every day, with the utmost joy and passion.
 
Our headquarters in Paris and in Amsterdam are home to a highly diverse and driven team of KARL family members that hail from over 35 countries. Together, we aim to create meaningful stories and product concepts that connect to Karl’s world and iconic attributes.
 
Women’s & Men's ready-to-wear, bags, small leather goods, swimwear and underwear are managed directly from our Amsterdam headquarters, while other categories, including footwear, fragrances, eyewear and more, are developed with best-in-class licensing partners.
 
We connect with our consumers on multiple levels, ensuring that our online and offline approach goes hand in hand. We thrive to maximize consumer engagement via more than 200 KL stores worldwide, our premium wholesale partners, and our strong digital footprint, spearheaded by our  karllagerfeld.com and 35 countries. Our digital channels currently represent more than 30% of our overall full-price business.
 
We are a dynamic, fast-growing and inclusive company built on professionalism and strong values. At KARL LAGERFELD we’re committed to working toward the highest standards of sustainability and integrity across all areas of our business,. In 2019, KARL LAGERFELD joined as a founding member of the Fashion Pact, a global sustainability initiative seeking to transform the fashion industry through objectives in three areas: climate, biodiversity and ocean protection.

THE ROLE

Are you looking to join a dynamic, fast-growing international fashion and retail company? We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Senior Accounts Payable Coordinator to support our Finance team. 

This role is responsible for managing the end-to-end accounts payable process, ensuring timely and accurate invoice processing, payment execution, vendor management, and compliance with internal controls.

The ideal candidate has experience working with Finance ERP, Medius AP Automation, and possesses a solid understanding of the Purchase Order (PO) lifecycle within a retail environment. You will thrive in a fast-paced international setting, demonstrate strong organizational skills, and maintain a high level of accuracy and professionalism.

Reporting directly to the Accounts Payable Team Lead, you will play a key role in supporting the financial operations of the business.

Invoice Processing & Vendor Management

• Process supplier invoices accurately and efficiently through Medius and M3, ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures.

• Monitor and manage invoice workflows, ensuring timely approvals and resolution of exceptions.
• Maintain vendor master data, including the creation, modification, and validation of supplier records.
• Develop and maintain strong relationships with external vendors and internal stakeholders.

Purchase Order Management

• Review and validate invoices against approved Purchase Orders and Goods Receipts.
• Investigate and resolve PO-related discrepancies, including price variances, quantity mismatches, and missing receipts.
• Work closely with Procurement, Retail Operations, and business stakeholders to ensure adherence to the Purchase-to-Pay (P2P) process.
• Support continuous improvement of PO compliance and invoice automation processes.

Payments & Cash Management

• Prepare and process weekly payment runs, including both batch and manual payments, ensuring adherence to agreed payment terms.
• Respond promptly to supplier inquiries regarding payment status and account reconciliations.
• Record and reconcile bank transactions accurately within the accounting system.

Reconciliations & Controls

• Perform regular supplier statement reconciliations and proactively resolve discrepancies.
• Monitor AP aging balances and follow up on outstanding items to ensure timely resolution.
• Support month-end and year-end closing activities related to accounts payable.
• Ensure compliance with internal controls, financial policies, and audit requirements.
• Assist with internal and external audits by providing supporting documentation and responding to audit requests.

Team & Administrative Support

• Manage shared Accounts Payable mailboxes, ensuring effective communication and timely handling of requests.
• Process employee expense claims in accordance with company policies and approval procedures.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of Accounts Payable processes and finance operations.
• Support day-to-day Finance department activities as required.

THE PROFILE:

Experience & Knowledge

• Minimum 3-4 years of Accounts Payable experience, preferably within an international retail, fashion, or consumer goods environment.
• Hands-on experience with M3 ERP and Medius AP Automation is highly preferred.
• Strong understanding of the Purchase-to-Pay (P2P) process, including Purchase Orders, Goods Receipts, and invoice matching.
• Good knowledge of European VAT regulations and invoice compliance requirements.
• Experience with vendor reconciliations, payment processing, and month-end activities.

• Relevant accounting or Accounts Payable certifications are considered an advantage.

• Strong analytical skills with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
• Ability to prioritize workload effectively and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong problem-solving capabilities and proactive mindset.
• Professional integrity with a commitment to confidentiality and compliance.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken; Spanish is a plus.

What We Offer

• The opportunity to work for globally recognized fashion and lifestyle brand.
• A collaborative and international working environment.
• Career development opportunities within a growing organization.
• Exposure to end-to-end finance operations and continuous process improvement initiatives.

jobs.title: Junior Data & Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

The Data & Automations Team

The Data & Automations team builds and operates Pigment's internal data platform, and designs, implements, and maintains the intelligent automation solutions that rely on it. Together, they streamline business processes and enhance data-driven decision making: we empower product, business and corporate functions through technology integration, robust data architecture, and process optimization, enabling teams to focus on high-value activities while ensuring accuracy and scalability.

The data platform is the foundation of everything we deliver. It is a centralized, governed ecosystem that collects, stores, transforms, and serves data to internal consumers across Product, Go-To-Market (GTM), and General & Administrative (G&A) functions, providing a single source of truth for analytics, automations, and AI. Making it reliable, secure, cost-efficient, and scalable is at the core of our mission. The team also consolidates and orchestrates AI efforts across Pigment, from governance and enablement to building AI-powered solutions.

Our team tackles diverse challenges, from integrating finance and HR systems and streamlining employee lifecycle processes, to building pipelines that turn product usage and customer interactions into actionable insights for Finance or GTM teams. AI is now at the center of most of what we do with data: many of our pipelines feed LLM-powered solutions, and the quality, structure, and governance of our data architecture directly determine what these solutions can deliver.

The team is led by Pigment's Deputy CISO and works closely with the Security team: security and data governance are part of how we build, not an afterthought.

Role

As a Junior Data and Automations Engineer, you will contribute to the continued development of Pigment's data platform: ingestion pipelines, dbt models, orchestration, data quality, and the underlying cloud infrastructure. You will also build and maintain the data pipelines, automations, and AI projects that support our G&A (Finance, People, IT) and GTM (Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships) teams.

You will work closely with senior engineers, starting with well-scoped tasks and progressively taking ownership of small projects end to end, from requirements gathering to production monitoring. This role involves collaborating with a wide range of internal stakeholders and requires excellent communication skills in English (primarily) and French, verbal and written.

Tech environment

Our core stack relies on Google Cloud Platform, maintained with Terraform, with components including BigQuery, Cloud Run, and Cloud Composer (Airflow), as well as dbt, Fivetran, Hightouch, Elementary for data observability, and Python for integrations and automations. Our pipelines connect business systems such as Salesforce, NetSuite, our HRIS, Gong, or Slack, and feed Pigment applications used by our own business teams. We also build LLM-powered pipelines and use AI tools in our daily engineering work.

You will have the opportunity to learn and grow your skills across these technologies while making a meaningful impact on Pigment's operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Under the supervision of the Data & Automations team's more senior members, you will participate in addressing the following topics.

Data Platform & Infrastructure:

  • Develop and maintain ingestion pipelines from APIs, databases, and SaaS tools, using Fivetran, Airflow, and Python
  • Build and maintain dbt models that turn raw data into clean, documented, and tested datasets
  • Contribute to the evolution of our orchestration, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code setup
  • Help improve data quality, observability, and alerting across the platform

G&A and GTM Data Pipelines & Automations:

  • Build pipelines and integrations that sync data between business systems (CRM, ERP, HRIS) through our data warehouse, including reverse ETL with Hightouch
  • Develop Python-based automations that remove manual work for teams such as Finance, People, IT, and Customer Success
  • Prepare reliable datasets for reporting and for the Pigment applications used by business teams

AI Projects:

  • Contribute to AI-powered solutions, such as LLM pipelines that extract, classify, and enrich unstructured data (call transcripts, messages, tickets)
  • Build the data foundations these projects rely on: AI-ready datasets, usage and observability data, evaluation data
  • Apply data architecture principles that make our data reliable, well-documented, and safely accessible for AI use cases (context, retrieval, access scoping)

Monitoring & Support:

  • Monitor pipelines and automations, troubleshoot incidents, and fix root causes
  • Document data models, pipelines, and processes for both technical and business readers

Collaboration & Learning:

By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company.   • Design DC/DC converters, power conditioning, and battery interface circuits.
  • Perform thermal analysis and optimize designs for efficiency and reliability.
  • Select power semiconductors, magnetic components, and protection devices.
  • Conduct circuit simulation and validate power electronics performance.
  • Support prototype testing, fault analysis, and hardware debugging.
  • Ensure compliance with (std), (std), (std), EMC, and reliability requirements.
  • Collaborate with mechanical and system engineers on integration and packaging.

Who You Are
  • 8+ years of professional experience in power electronics design for industrial, aerospace, or defense applications.

jobs.description:
About Moneybox
 
At Moneybox, our mission is to give everyone the means to get more out of life. Moneybox is an award-winning wealth management platform, helping over one and a half million people build wealth throughout their lives, whether they’re saving and investing, buying their first home, or planning for retirement.
 
Job Brief

Moneybox engineering serves more than 2M customers and runs a live service handling over 20M API requests a day. We have agreed a company-wide AI Platforms strategy, backed by a business case, and we are now building the team to deliver it. This is a newly created function and you will be its first hire.

The Head of AI Platforms & Deployment is a player-manager role reporting to the Engineering Director, owning both sides of that strategy: the AI Platforms capability pillars (control, monitoring and sandboxing; agentic workflow orchestration; knowledge capture) and the AI Deployment team of forward-deployed engineers who put AI to work on real business problems. You will be hands-on from day one - enabling business deployment of AI with the tools we have today - whilst also building and delivering a business-driven, multi-year AI platforms strategy and hiring and managing the team that executes it.

Why now:

  • AI offers Moneybox significant opportunities, and unlocking them safely means managing the risks that come with it. The controls and capabilities that make that possible (gateways, sandboxing, guardrails, monitoring, perimeter defence) need dedicated leadership to build.
  • Demand for AI-enabled business systems is real and, without a safe path, goes underground. Someone must own the graduation ladder from "works for me" to owned, reviewed business system.
  • We are hosting customer-facing AI models as part of our Aurora financial guidance service. Serving these safely, securely and at scale needs a dedicated engineering owner.
  • We need to evolve our current Claude, Gemini and other frontier LLM deployments into a coherent, safe and effective strategic deployment platform.
You are not coming in to write a strategy deck. Pace and learning are key: we expect you to run two tracks in parallel from day one - enable the do-ers, helping the business use AI safely with what we have today rather than gating everything behind platform build, and build the strategic platform. Key decisions should be made within your first two to three months and material platform improvements live within six. You will hire further engineers before the end of the year, growing the team as the benefits compound.

What You'll Do

Own the AI platform strategy. Risk management, horizon scanning, supplier selection and vendor management, business case ownership, and benefits realisation through a coherent, business-driven delivery roadmap that is trusted by stakeholders across Moneybox.

Build and lead the AI Deployment team. Hire, line-manage and set the engagement priorities and delivery standards for a team of forward-deployed AI engineers, working alongside embedded specialists while we hire. Grow into managing both the platform and deployment sub-teams as the function expands.

Own perimeter safety in an AI-native world. Set and own our defensive AI strategy, with execution carried out in collaboration with Tech Ops. Our Principal Cloud Architect, who owns overall cloud strategy, is a key partner.

Own AI platforms and costs. Harnesses, tooling, cost management, forecasting and optimisation (including usage-based pricing shifts), and the staff access model. This includes:

  • AI safety for internal use: sandboxing, policy, integrations, MCP governance, usage guardrails and monitoring expectations.
  • The three platform pillars: control, monitoring and sandboxing (LLM and MCP gateway, anonymisation, local hardening, sandboxed cloud agent hosting); agentic workflow orchestration (a "software factory" in the cloud with hybrid self-serve and engineering-managed workflows); and knowledge capture and organisation.
  • AI workflow tooling and the tiered graduation ladder from personal tool, to shared tool, to business system.
  • Evolving existing deployments: tactical enhancement of what we run today so it aligns with the strategic direction.

    • Own model hosting and scaling. Hosting and scaling for AI and model workloads, including the customer-facing models behind our Aurora financial guidance service, with execution in collaboration with Tech Ops. Model safety and performance for customer-facing AI is shared with our Decisioning and Data Science teams: they own what happens inside the model, you own everything surrounding it.

    Enable the do-ers. Give departments a working answer for using AI today - clear guardrails on what is allowed now and fast risk assessment rather than blanket restriction - and make sure demand arrives through the front door.

    This role is explicitly not ML model development or data science, general cloud infrastructure ownership, or general engineering delivery - although our squads and engineering leads are customers of the platforms you build.


    Who You Are
  • A proven engineering leader who has gone deep on AI. You have managed engineers and managers, run programmes, owned budgets and supplier relationships, and in the last two to three years you have owned an AI platform or enablement capability in a real organisation. Not a spectator or strategist-only.
  • A player-manager. You are comfortable getting hands-on in the early months and equally comfortable stepping back as the team you have hired takes it on.
  • Strategic and accountable. You build and deliver a 12-18 month strategy aligned to company objectives, make well-informed and timely decisions, and take full ownership of your function's performance and commitments.
  • Unusually cross-functional. Every department is your stakeholder and customer. You will be recognised as the AI platforms expert at Moneybox, influencing exec and departmental leaders and resolving boundaries with Tech Ops and Decisioning through shared goals rather than turf.
  • A team builder. You will build this team from scratch rather than inherit one, establishing a performance culture, developing your people, and running a team that itself models AI-enabled productivity.
  • Commercially literate. You can express platform investment in ROI and EBITDA terms to a non-technical exec, and defend a risk position - on a connector approval, a token-versus-agent permission gap, a vendor - with clear reasoning.

    • Experience & Skill

    Essential

  • Proven engineering leadership: has managed engineers and managers, run programmes, owned budgets and supplier relationships.
  • Has owned an AI platform or enablement capability in a real organisation in the last 2-3 years: deployed AI tooling company-wide, set governance, managed cost at scale.
  • Has built or significantly scaled a team.
  • Current, hands-on fluency with the modern AI stack: frontier model platforms, agentic tooling and harnesses, MCP and integration patterns, evals, prompt and context engineering.
  • AI security and governance: sandboxing, gateways (LLM, MCP, AI), DLP, guardrail enforcement and data-boundary reasoning; able to form and defend risk positions.
  • Cost engineering: usage-based pricing models, forecasting and optimisation levers.
  • Enough software and cloud architecture depth to hold your own with Architects, Tech Ops and Decisioning, and to get hands-on with the platform in the early months. Our core stack is .NET on Azure and Python is the standard for AI, so we need polyglot pragmatism over allegiance to any single stack.

  • Experience serving customer-facing AI models in production and partnering with data science teams on model safety and performance.

You will work on three types of project:

Embed with departments to AI-enable tasks and processes in a more sophisticated way than "just ask Claude" - for example, Python pipelines where one step is an LLM API call - delivering real incremental value with each engagement and transforming working patterns into load-bearing, AI-enabled business processes.
  • Customer-facing AI deployment. Deploy and integrate AI components built by our ML and Decisioning teams into production: the engineering implementation layer between a working model and a live customer feature.
  • AI platform capabilities. Work with the AI Platforms team to turn engagement patterns into safe, increasingly self-serve company-wide tooling.

Departments across Moneybox are already building AI tools themselves - we want to provide them with a safe path to load-bearing use at scale. This role catches that demand and matures it properly.


What You'll Do
  • Own engagement delivery end to end. Scope with the department, design the solution, build it, deploy it, and agree the handover and ownership model - from prototype through to stable production. Engagements arrive as vague pain; you define the problem, not just the solution.

    Who You Are
  • A production engineer with AI at the core. You have built and shipped LLM-powered systems that ran in production and can talk concretely about evals, failure modes, cost curves, and what you would do differently.

          •

            •

            • Own the PS operational cadence: weekly utilisation reviews, monthly P&L and scorecard reviews, quarterly operational reviews — ensure each is well-structured, data-driven, and action-oriented.

Role overview:

We are looking for an experienced contractor to lead the analysis, design and execution of a data migration from one Salesforce instance (source org) to another (target org), using Microsoft SQL Server as the staging and transformation layer. You will own the end-to-end migration data workstream: profiling source data, mapping objects and fields, building transformation logic, loading and reconciling data, and supporting cutover.

This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role. The right person will combine strong Salesforce data model knowledge with proven, real-world experience of moving data between orgs safely and accurately.   • Define and document the data migration approach, scope, and sequencing for moving data between Salesforce orgs, including cutover and rollback considerations.
  • Analyse and profile source Salesforce data to assess volumes, quality, duplication, and dependencies across standard and custom objects.
  • Produce object-level and field-level mapping documents between source and target orgs, covering data types, picklist values, record types, required fields, and validation rules.
  • Design and maintain SQL Server staging databases and schemas to extract, cleanse, transform, and stage Salesforce data ahead of loading.
  • Write, optimise, and test T-SQL (stored procedures, views, ETL logic) to implement transformation and data-cleansing rules.
  • Manage the migration of parent/child relationships and record ownership, preserving referential integrity through ID cross-referencing (source ID to target ID) and correct load order.
  • Extract and load data using appropriate tooling (e.g., Salesforce Data Loader, Bulk API, SSIS, Azure Data Factory, dbAmp, or equivalent) and manage error handling and re-runs.

  • Design and run reconciliation and validation checks (record counts, field-level comparisons, sampling) and produce sign-off evidence for business stakeholders.
  • Work with Salesforce administrators, developers, business analysts, and data owners to resolve data quality issues and agree transformation rules.
  • Identify and manage migration risks and issues, including data volume limits, API limits, automation and trigger impacts, and sharing/ownership considerations.

  • Proven success leading global launches and live service marketing for multi-product portfolios

  • Experience building and leading multidisciplinary creative teams (art, video, design, copy)  

  • Track record using player insights, segmentation, and AI tooling to sharpen creative and media decisions  

  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to operate across matrixed, global organizations

  • Willingness to relocate to Frankfurt am Main, Germany

Career Path 
Your professional development is important to us, so we have laid out a career plan to help you progress towards your goals and objectives. 
 
Relocation Support

German Classes

Events
